[AAPL | 10-K FY2023 | Section: Item 1. Business]
ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, and sells a variety of related services. Products include iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Wearables, Home and Accessories. Services include Advertising, AppleCare, Cloud Services, Digital Content, and Payment Services.

[AAPL | 10-K FY2023 | Section: Item 1A. Risk Factors]
ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS

Global economic conditions, geopolitical conflicts, and trade disputes could adversely affect the Company's business. In particular, substantially all of the Company's manufacturing is performed by outsourced partners located primarily in Asia, including mainland China, India, and Vietnam. Any disruption at these manufacturing facilities could severely limit supply.

[AAPL | 10-K FY2023 | Section: Item 7. MD&A]
ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

Total net sales decreased 3% or $11.0 billion during 2023 compared to 2022. Products net sales decreased due to lower sales of Mac and iPad. Services net sales increased 9% driven by growth in advertising, App Store, and cloud services.

Research and development expense was $29,915 million in 2023, compared to $26,251 million in 2022, representing an increase of 14% to support next-generation silicon, AI technologies, and visionOS platform development.

[AAPL | 10-K FY2023 | Section: Item 8. Financial Statements]
ITEM 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA

Consolidated Statements of Operations (in millions):

[AAPL | Transcript FY2023 | Section: Executive Remarks & Presentation]
EXECUTIVE REMARKS & PRESENTATION:
        Tim Cook (CEO): Good afternoon, everyone. Today Apple is reporting revenue of $81.8 billion for the June quarter. We hit an all-time revenue record in India, growing strong double digits, driven by robust iPhone adoption and the opening of our first two retail stores in Mumbai and Delhi. We continue to invest heavily in artificial intelligence and machine learning, which are foundational technologies woven into virtually every product we build.

        Luca Maestri (CFO): Our Services revenue set an all-time record of $21.2 billion, up 8% year-over-year. We reached over 1 billion paid subscriptions across the services on our platform.

[AAPL | Transcript FY2023 | Section: Analyst Q&A Session]
QUESTION AND ANSWER SECTION:
        Shannon Cross (Analyst): Tim, can you discuss the trajectory of AI spending and silicon development?
        Tim Cook: We view AI and ML as fundamental core technologies, and we have been doing research across a wide range of AI technologies, including generative AI, for years.

ITEM 1. BUSINESS

[MSFT | Transcript FY2023 | Section: Executive Remarks & Presentation]
EXECUTIVE REMARKS & PRESENTATION:
        Satya Nadella (CEO): We had a tremendous close to the fiscal year. Microsoft Cloud annual revenue surpassed $110 billion, up 27% in constant currency. Azure OpenAI Service now has more than 11,00 organizations using the service, up from 4,500 just last quarter. Organizations are choosing Azure because of our leading infrastructure and enterprise-grade security.

[MSFT | Transcript FY2023 | Section: Analyst Q&A Session]
QUESTION AND ANSWER SECTION:

        Satya Nadella: Copilot is being rapidly adopted across GitHub, Microsoft 365, and Power Platform. GitHub Copilot has over 1 million paying users.

[NVDA | 10-K FY2024 | Section: Item 1. Business]
ITEM 1. BUSINESS

NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems. We specialize in GPUs, DPUs, and full-stack software platforms powering AI supercomputing.

[NVDA | 10-K FY2024 | Section: Item 7. MD&A]
ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS

Fiscal year 2024 was a transformative year. Total revenue increased 126% to $60,922 million, driven by exceptional growth in our Data Center platform following the enterprise inflection point for generative AI.

Gross margin expanded significantly to 72.7% from 56.9% in fiscal 2023, reflecting higher Data Center architecture sales.

[NVDA | Transcript FY2024 | Section: Executive Remarks & Presentation]
EXECUTIVE REMARKS & PRESENTATION:
        Jensen Huang (CEO): Accelerated computing and generative AI have reached the tipping point. Demand is surging worldwide across companies, industries and nations. Our Data Center platform is powered by increasingly diverse drivers — demand for data processing, training and inference from large cloud service providers and GPU specialized providers, as well as from enterprise software and consumer internet companies.

[NVDA | Transcript FY2024 | Section: Analyst Q&A Session]
QUESTION AND ANSWER SECTION:
        Toshiya Hari (Analyst): Jensen, how do you see Blackwell transition impacting supply?
        Jensen Huang: The demand for Blackwell is incredible. Supply will be constrained through the coming fiscal year as customer demand exceeds available capacity.
